{{EventEnded|date = 8th of May 2021|event = [[Halloween 2020 Event]]}} {{for|the [[Citizen 2]]|[[Citizen Plush]]}} {{UnitInfobox |image-static = Citizen1.png |image-dynamic = Citizen1Dynamic.png |image-dynamic-start = 0 |source = [[Trick or Threat Town]] Wave 18 |type = Humanoid |health = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]135 |spawnrate = Variable |damage_type = Single
Collision |ranged_damage = [[File:OffensiveModifier.png|20px|Damage]]60 |ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]1.03 |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]8 |speed = 3 |hidden = No |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} (Collision only) |flying = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Citizen 1''' was a unique [[units|unit]] not spawned by a specific [[tower]]. It appeared during [[Trick or Threat Town]] on Wave 18 to support your towers. It stopped to attack an enemy when it detected one in its range. It was a melee unit, so it had short range. However, it dealt high damage and had a relatively high firerate. ==Appearance== The '''Citizen 1''' had tan skin. It had a beige shirt, brown legs and black shoes. It wore a dusty farmer cap. It wielded a pitchfork to attack enemies. ==Strategy== *The '''Citizen 1''' spawns interchangeably with the [[Citizen 2]]. **When wave 18 starts, five random citizens (either '''1''' or [[Citizen 2|2]]) will spawn. After that, every 12-17 seconds, another random citizen will spawn. *Do not rely solely on the '''Citizen 1''' for damage. They should only be used as a desperate last resort when [[Lord Sinister]] approaches the end of the map. **The '''Citizen 1''' is most useful against weaker enemies summoned by [[Lord Sinister]], like the [[Hallow Bones]]. Treat them as passive damage rather than a main attacking source. *If [[Lord Sinister]] uses its ''Infernal Storm'' attack, and a '''Citizen 1''' is caught in the attack, it is instantly killed. *The '''Citizen 1''' cannot detect [[flying]] or [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies. It also cannot collide with the [[Ghost (Trick or Threat Town)|Ghost]] as it is a ghost enemy. ==Trivia== *The '''Citizen 1''' was one of two [[units]] without an associated tower or consumable, alongside the [[Citizen 2]]. **This unit was more defensive-based than the [[Citizen 2]], as it had higher health and longer range in comparison. However, it had slower speed and lower DPS. *The pitchfork used by the '''Citizen 1''' is the {{RLinkC|101106419|Farmer's Revenge}} gear from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== *'''31 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.1|Overhaul v1.1.0]] **'''Citizen 1''' added. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Citizen 1''' removed. {{TowerNavBox}} [[Category:Trick or Threat Town]]
